summary: Phase A+B+B+ on-demand SKU storefront fully tested. All 21 backend pytest cases PASS (catalog seeding & defaults, admin price edits with 403 guards, reset-defaults, idempotent in-house solutions seed, entitlements/access-check, Razorpay order creation for L1/L2/L3/L4, forged-signature rejection, PDF flow incl. 402 without entitlement, 200 + %PDF magic bytes after L1 grant, idempotent re-download not consuming L1, cross-module bindings dezider/pros_cons/swot, 404 unknown decision, 400 unknown module). Frontend /store renders all 4 SKU cards with ₹199/₹999/₹1999/₹2800 + Monthly Subscription tile in mobile viewport. /admin/sku-pricing renders 4 editable cards with name/tagline/description/price/quota/active + Reset defaults + Seed in-house buttons. Admin nav 'On-Demand SKUs' correctly placed between Tier Matrix and Customer Segments. PaywallGate and ModuleStoreActions present and wired into swot.tsx, pros-cons-list.tsx, dezider-list.tsx. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (warning logged on every page load).

issues: Price for ₹1,999 renders as '₹1999' (no thousands separator) — minor formatting nit in store.tsx formatINR helper; not blocking

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package warning fired on app load: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages to replace the required functionality.' Migrate to expo-audio / expo-video.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Update store.tsx formatINR to insert thousands separators so ₹1,999 / ₹2,800 render with commas like the design intent.
(Optional) Migrate expo-av usages to expo-audio / expo-video (SDK 54 removal). Out of scope for this phase but flagged.

(Optional) Add testID props to PaywallGate sheet rows, ModuleStoreActions pills, /store buy buttons, and admin sku-pricing Save/Reset/Seed buttons so subsequent agents can target them deterministically.
